title: 1954 AHSME Problem 27
statement: A right circular cone has for its base a circle having the same radius as a given sphere. The volume of the cone is one-half that of the sphere. The ratio of the altitude of the cone to the radius of its base is:

solutions.text:
The volume condition is \[ \frac13\pi r^2h=\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right). \] Cancelling the common factors gives \(h=2r,\) so the requested ratio is \(2:1.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Write both volumes using their common radius \(r\)
Set \(\frac13\pi r^2h\) equal to half of \(\frac43\pi r^3\)
